candidates.title: Will it rain in Houston on Nov 8, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLIHOU in Houston in Nov 8, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLIHOU can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will there be at least 1 presidential nomination sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 8, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 1 nomination to the U.S. Senate from Nov 8, 2026 through Nov 14, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 15, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 15, 2026.
The week runs from Nov 8, 2026 through Nov 14, 2026.

Payout criteria

If a person receives multiple qualifying nominations within the period, they will each count separately.
For example, Trump's March 4 nomination of Kevin Warsh is considered two nominations.

candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be below 38.1 according to RealClearPolitics?
candidates.rules_primary: If the President's approval rating is below 38.1% at 11:00 AM ET on November 13, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 13, 2026.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 59-60° on Nov 9, 2026?

Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.
